name: Praesertum Forum
description: The Praesertum Forum is the ceremonial and governmental apex of Ka Vethan. Here, Praesertum decrees are issued, civic doctrine is shaped, and void‑arcane resonance is aligned with Akhevan governance. The Forum’s Luclinite amphitheater, decree spires, resonance dais, and void‑aligned council chambers serve as the central stage for political authority and ritual proclamation.
